newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dlr supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dlr supply.

text.p: Some fresh inflow of the U.S. currency helped the Bangladesh taka to close firmer at 43.7350/7400 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday, dealers said.
This compares with the previous close at 43.7460/7500.

The local unit opened mostly steady at 43.7450/7500 per dollar but gained later amid increased selling by both state-owned and foreign banks. "The market has got a large volume of dollar mostly from wage earners," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed softer at 5.5 to 9.5 against previous 7.0-10 percent.
